repairs.issue: 챔피언별 보호막/조건 이속이 무조건 합산될 위험, 잃은 체력을 maxHealth로 오표기
repairs.correction: 조건부 증분 분리와 접근 시 대체; 회복의 maxHealth 계수 제거
repairs.quote: Shyvana wraps herself in flames for 2.5 seconds, gaining (60/80/100/120/140 + (12% bonus Health)) Shield, increased by (18/24/30/36/42 + (3.6% bonus Health)) per nearby enemy champion and 25% Move Speed, increased to 43.75% when moving towards enemy champions. When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing (80/100/120/140/160 + (65% Ability Power)) magic damage. Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for (60 ~ 100) + (4% ~ 8%) Missing Health.

proposalDecisions.reason: Missing Health는 maxHealth가 아니므로 stat=null로 변경; 스키마 부족을 unsupported_formula로 기록.
